explanation: This test only verifies that the FX rate shown matches the rate at initiation, partially covering the 'fx_lock' requirement. It does not test the transactional order of crediting the wallet before debiting the funding source ('credit_before_debit'), nor does it cover the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 ('dual_approval'). The test also lacks verification of the actual locking mechanism or rollback behavior on callback timeout. It misses asserting that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited, and it does not test the approval workflow for large top-ups.
missingAssertions: Assert that the destination wallet balance increases before the funding source is debited
Assert that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the wallet is credited, causing inconsistent balances, would not be caught. Also, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 proceed without second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify transactional integrity and approval workflow for multi-currency wallet top-ups
steps: Initiate a top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify that the FX rate used for conversion matches the recorded rate
Confirm that the destination wallet balance increases before the funding source is debited
Simulate payment provider callback timeout and verify that neither wallet nor funding source balances change
Attempt to settle without second-owner approval and verify settlement is blocked
Obtain second-owner approval and verify settlement completes successfully, with wallet credited and funding source debited in correct order
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; transaction rolls back if callback times out
